description: SushiSwap route quote for an exact-input swap on one EVM chain: amount out, swap price, price impact, gas spent and the tokens in the route. Quote only, no transaction data. The API needs a sender address; if none is given, a fixed placeholder address is sent and nothing is signed or executed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

amountIn.description: Amount to sell in the token's smallest unit (wei for 18 decimals)

sender.description: Optional sender address for the API (quote unaffected)

tokenIn.description: Token to sell, 0x address (use the wrapped token for native ETH)

name: crypto_sushiswap_route_quotes
title: Crypto Sushiswap Route Quotes
